The external player stays unloaded until you choose to open it.

Last updated: 26 October 2026. This working notice describes the services currently present in the website.

Before you load a player

Opening the homepage does not load a YouTube or Instagram player. Locally hosted travel videos are served by the website. Optional advertising and Google Analytics use one Google privacy message. Advertising requests stay paused and the Analytics tag stays unloaded until the message supplies the relevant granted choice. Loading the Google consent service itself makes technical requests to Google; it is not a promise of zero network activity before a choice.

When you choose YouTube or Instagram

Pressing a player’s load button connects to that platform. YouTube or Instagram may then receive technical information and use cookies or similar technologies according to their own policies. The permission applies to that player only and is not saved as a permanent preference. Closing the player removes the embed.

You can instead use the direct platform link. Read Google’s privacy policy ↗ or Instagram’s privacy policy ↗.

Forms and owner sign-in

The website’s Q&A forms use Firebase App Check/reCAPTCHA to help prevent abuse. The private owner area also uses Firebase Authentication to keep the owner signed in. These security services may use browser storage and process technical device and network data. They are separate from optional media players.

Postcards sign-up

The Postcards email form is embedded in the sign-up section and loads near that section. It connects to Brevo and Google reCAPTCHA for registration and spam protection. When it loads, Brevo and Google may use storage and process device and network information for sign-up, delivery and abuse prevention under their own policies. See the privacy notice for provider links and subscription choices.

One choice for advertising and Analytics

The live website uses Google’s certified consent management platform for AdSense and Google Analytics. The message offers Consent, Do not consent and Manage options. Manage options lets you review storage, data purposes and the selected Google advertising provider. Google maps the storage purpose to Analytics consent; this is not a second Analytics popup or a separate Analytics switch.

Consent is optional. Without a valid granted signal, advertising requests stay paused and Analytics stays off. If Google does not supply an applicable consent choice in your region, both stay off. Rejecting does not prevent reading the website or using its forms. Analytics is not loaded on the test website, owner admin, editor previews, error/redirect pages or the dedicated contact, Q&A and sign-up form pages. These areas do not serve advertising.

The consent choice is managed by Google’s CMP and can be changed using Privacy and cookie settings. The old Analytics-only browser choice is not reused as advertising consent. Changing an existing choice reloads the page to apply the newly saved decision. Revoking Analytics stops subsequent measurement and clears this site’s Analytics cookies; it does not erase information already sent.

When allowed, Analytics cookies (_ga and _ga_…) are configured to last up to six months. Advertising and consent storage have their own Google-managed lifetimes. Read the privacy notice, how Google uses information from partner sites and Google’s cookie information.

Privacy and cookie settings

Open the same Google message to review or withdraw your choices for advertising and Analytics. This does not control external players you deliberately load or necessary security checks.

Your browser controls

You can clear site data or manage cookies through your browser. Blocking security-related storage can affect sign-in or protected forms. See the privacy notice for the information collected by website features.
